svg.title: The DFA for a?a?a?aaa built while it reads aabaaa and then aaa: each set of NFA states becomes a state the first time it comes, and is reused after
svg.text: each DFA state is a set of the NFA's states (04.03), and keeps where each byte took it

g.title: Line aabaaa: before the first byte the NFA's start states, {1 3 5 6}, are a set never seen: it is built as D0, with every transition unknown.
g.text: built: a new set of NFA states, a new state
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "a" at 0: D0 has no transition on it yet: worked out from the NFA, it leads to a new set, built as D1, and kept in D0's table.
g.text: built: a new set of NFA states, a new state
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "a" at 1: D1 has no transition on it yet: worked out from the NFA, it leads to a new set, built as D2, and kept in D1's table.
g.text: built: a new set of NFA states, a new state
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "b" at 2: worked out from the NFA, it leads to {1 3 5 6}: the hash table has that set already, as D0. No new state.
g.text: found: worked out from the NFA, the set already a state
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "a" at 3: D0 has been through "a" before: one lookup, D1. A hit: no NFA work.
g.text: hit: the state's table had it
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "a" at 4: D1 has been through "a" before: one lookup, D2. A hit: no NFA work.
g.text: hit: the state's table had it
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: "a" at 5: D2 has no transition on it yet: worked out from the NFA, it leads to a new set, built as D3, which holds the match state.
g.text: built: a new set of NFA states, a new state
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02

g.title: The next line, aaa: start in D0, and every byte is a hit, one lookup in the state's table. The NFA does no work at all; D3 matches.
g.text: hit: the state's table had it
D0 to D3 are found by their sets in the hash table of 01.02
